description: This file defines a class 'Colors' which manages CSS color names and their RGB equivalents. It includes methods for converting color names to RGBA arrays and vice versa, with a static list of CSS color names and their RGB values.

classes.name: Colors
classes.description: Provides static methods to convert CSS color names to RGBA arrays and vice versa, utilizing a predefined list of CSS color names and their RGB values.

methods.name: colorNameToRGBa
methods.description: Converts a CSS color name to an RGBA array with integer values, or returns null if not found.

methods.name: RGBaToColorName
methods.description: Converts RGB (and optional alpha) values back to a CSS color name if it exists, or null otherwise.
